description.narrative: The proposed project will improve the Khevi-Ubisa section and improve operations and maintenance of the road network, as well as road safety. Further, the project's focus on climate resilient design will contribute to mainstreaming the sustainability of Georgia's road network.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3715: 91% of contracts awarded and 89% disbursed as of 20 Jun 2025
Progress Toward Outcome: Construction of the Khevi-Ubisa Section (F2) was substantially completed, and the road was inaugurated on 28 October 2023.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Aug 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/49257/49257-001-apfs-en_4.pdf
Some results are in the Environmental Impact Assessments | Nov 2019: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/49257/49257-001-eia-en_35.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Sep 2018: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/49257/49257-001-rp-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Jul 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/49257/49257-001-smr-en_15.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: 1. The Khevi-Ubisa Section (F2) is currently under the Defects Notification Period.
2. Consultants for road safety awareness, and entrepreneurship and livelihood development training have been recruited and activities are ongoing.
3. Preparation of the detailed design for Tbilisi Bypass is ongoing and expected to be completed by 30 June 2024.
